@YouTheReal  

I ported my family health insurance from HDFC ERGO which was initially done during 2018 to Niva Bupa insurance 6 months back. Now my son has to undergo a minor surgery but Niva bupa is declining my request for insurance quoting that i need to complete 24 months. What I was committed during porting is that there will be no waiting period in a email. Also I understand that as per guidelines new insurer should honor the waiting period of my previous insurer.

When I called up the service desk  team 2 days back i was told that the continuity benefits is not mapped to my policy due to some technical glitch. It will get corrected within 2 hours. I have called more than 15+ times everytime explaining the issue. They seem to agree on the call but later i get automated email saying issue is resolved without explanation on resolution.

Now again couple of hours back i got email with denial of insurance.
 Since three days three times they have denied claim this is the most unethical practice i have seen and I’m really struggling to get Justice.
